newsitem.title: POLAND: HANDLOWY IN POLISH PIONEER'S REAL ESTATE FUND.
newsitem.headline: HANDLOWY IN POLISH PIONEER'S REAL ESTATE FUND.

text.p: A unit of Poland's largest commercial bank, Bank Handlowy SA, will take part in Pioneer First Polish Trust Fund Co's planned $60 million real estate fund, Pioneer's spokesman said on Friday.

Miroslaw Lubon told Reuters on Friday that Handlowy Inwestycje Sp z oo would contribute $10 million of the planned $60 million start-up capital of the close-end fund, called Polski Fundusz Nieruchomosci SA.
The fund would be the first of its kind in Poland.
Polish Pioneer would contribute four percent of the start-up capital, domestic institutional investors a total of 51 percent and foreign investors the rest.

"The firm has been formed and now the remaining shareholders who have expressed interest must physically increase its capital," Lubon said, adding that the process of gathering investors should be finished by this September.
Lubon reiterated Pioneer's plan for the fund, to invest in Polish commercial and residential property, to be listed on the Warsaw bourse in about three years.
Bank Handlowy, currently undergoing privatisation, is seen reaching the Warsaw bourse in this year's second half.
Pioneer First Polish Trust Fund Company is owned by Pioneer Group based in Boston. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
